raw_response:
This plot is only a small piece, less than a quarter hectare, and I am renting it, so I will not spend much cash on it. I went to school for some years so I know fertilizer helps, but one bag of DAP is too much money for this small rented plot, and if the owner takes it back next year I lose my investment. I will put the manure from our animals because that costs me nothing, and use the seed I saved from last harvest like my neighbors do. My husband works the bigger plots, so I handle this one mostly myself with help from my older child.
